entities.summary: Kanagawa University , abbreviated to Jindai (神大), is a private university in Japan. The main campus is located in Rokkakubashi, Kanagawa-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture. Kanagawa University is a university in Asia, established in 1928. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
